title: Anima mea liquefacta est (Gaspar, Motet cycle Ave mundi domina)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Motet cycle Ave mundi domina, Anima mea liquefacta est. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0301d), edited by Agnese Pavanello (MCE 5: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Ave mundi domina, 2021); encoded by Craig Stuart Sapp. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
